item.title: What is Macro?
item.description: What is Macro Photography? Macro photography is the art of capturing the tiny, often-overlooked details of the world around us. It’s all about getting up close and personal with your subject. Whether it’s the intricate texture of a dragonfly’s wing, the gears of a wristwatch, or the mesmerizing swirl of oil on water, macro opens up a world that normally escapes the naked eye. 1:1 vs 2:1 Magnification In macro photography, you’ll often hear terms like 1:1 or 2:1 thrown around.
